responsibility: This file implements LTO symbol-table and declaration merging after multiple IL files have been read into one compilation. It decides prevailing definitions among duplicate declarations, replaces redundant cgraph and varpool nodes while preserving references, edges, flags, TLS-model constraints, aliases, and comdat/inline state, resolves weakrefs and preempted symbols according to linker resolutions, and provides special prevailing-decl handling for virtual tables and other declarations that affect optimization even without ordinary symtab entries. In short, it is the post-read reconciliation layer that collapses per-object symbol graphs into one consistent GCC symtab.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the lto-symtab pair: it performs the actual post-read symbol and declaration merging, node replacement, alias handling, and prevailing-definition resolution, whereas gcc/lto/lto-symtab.h only exposes the merge entry points and inline prevailing-decl helpers.
